commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import copy, tomllib
from pathlib import Path
pairs=[('/tmp/pyasn1-base-root.lock','uv.lock','root'),('/tmp/pyasn1-base-pal.lock','docker/mcp-servers-source/pal/pal-mcp-server/uv.lock','pal')]
for base_path,cand_path,label in pairs:
    base=tomllib.loads(Path(base_path).read_text())
    cand=tomllib.loads(Path(cand_path).read_text())
    b_rows=[p for p in base.get('package',[]) if p.get('name')=='pyasn1']
    c_rows=[p for p in cand.get('package',[]) if p.get('name')=='pyasn1']
    print(label,'BASE_PYASN1=',b_rows)
    print(label,'CAND_PYASN1=',c_rows)
    if not c_rows or any(p.get('version')!='0.6.4' for p in c_rows):
        raise SystemExit(f'{label}: candidate pyasn1 is not exclusively 0.6.4')
    b=copy.deepcopy(base); c=copy.deepcopy(cand)
    b['package']=[p for p in b.get('package',[]) if p.get('name')!='pyasn1']
    c['package']=[p for p in c.get('package',[]) if p.get('name')!='pyasn1']
    if b != c:
        raise SystemExit(f'{label}: unrelated parsed lock structure changed')
PY
